components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode; when present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned identifier formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' from the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and a global 4-digit sequence.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners at the same last name and address.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitively) at the time it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Derived identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric level from 1 to 3 assigned on creation: starts at 1, +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The canonical region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'."
              type: string
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners were registered on this owner's registration date, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference

              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode; when present it must be valid for the city's region.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth; when present the response reports an ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner shares the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:

## Change: age-band derived from `birthDate`

The request may now carry an ISO `birthDate`; the owner response reports `ageBand` (`MINOR`/`ADULT`/`SENIOR`) computed from that birth date against the owner's `registrationDate`.

**Files touched:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added `birthDate` (date) to the `OwnerFields` request schema and `ageBand` (readOnly string) to the `Owner` response schema. The DTOs are code-generated from this spec, so these give `OwnerFieldsDto.birthDate` and `OwnerDto.ageBand` for free; MapStruct maps `birthDate` onto the entity by name.

2. **`Owner.java`** — added the persisted `birthDate` field with a plain getter/setter (CC 1 each), mirroring the existing `registrationDate` column.

3. **`AgeBand.java`** (new) — a small cohesive helper next to `ContactPreference`/`IdentityKey`: `Period.between(birthDate, registrationDate)` → band, `null` when no birth date. As a fresh single-purpose class it carries no surrounding complexity.

4. **`RespondWithOwner.java`** — one line, `dto.setAgeBand(AgeBand.of(owner))`, following the existing pattern for `contactPreference`/`checkDigit` on the GET path (the path the test reads back through).

5. **DB schemas/seeds** — added `birth_date DATE` to all four `schema.sql` files; hsqldb and mysql use positional seed inserts, so I appended a trailing `NULL` to each owners row (h2/postgres use column-list inserts and needed no seed change).

## One pre-existing bug I had to fix

The test creates an owner **without a postcode**, which surfaced a latent NPE unrelated to age-band: `AssignOwnerCustomerCode` intentionally calls `Locality.of(null, postcode)` to derive region from postcode alone, but with a null postcode it falls through to `of(null)`, and `Map.of(...).getOrDefault(null, …)` throws (immutable maps reject null keys). Create 500'd for any postcode-less owner. I guarded it in one line in `Locality.of(String)` (`null → "UNKNOWN"`), which is the intended semantics. Without this the new test's `createOwnerOk` couldn't succeed.

I kept structural impact low by putting the new logic in a zero-context helper class and touching each existing method by a single line, rather than growing the mapper (whose accumulated complexity would have been the expensive place to add it).
